texts.facts: This writ petition is filed by the petitioner for a direction to respondents 1 to 3 to establish an analysis mechanism consistent with international standards for the consignments which are meant for importing to India. Petitioner wants for a pre-import sample analysis in respect of the future consignment to be imported. The Standing Counsel submits that there is no such provision as per the request made by the petitioner.
